DEV_IPMI.description: Enable /dev/ipmi0 interface, used by ipmitool, ipmicmd, and other userspace IPMI-using applications.

IPMI_IMB.description: Enable "legacy" interfaces for applications Intel IMB driver interface

IPMI_POWERCYCLE.description: Enable IPMI_POWERCYCLE if you want the system to be power-cycled on reboot

IPMI_POWEROFF.description: Enable IPMI_POWEROFF if you want the IPMI poweroff module to be loaded.

IPMI_SI.description: Enable standard hardware interfaces (KCS, BT, SMIC)

IPMI_WATCHDOG.description: Enable IPMI_WATCHDOG if you want the IPMI watchdog to reboot the system if it hangs

IPMI_WATCHDOG_OPTIONS.description: Watchdog options - modinfo ipmi_watchdog for details
